samples.claim: DeletionFile path is {root}/_deletions/{fragment_id}-{read_version}-{id}.{extension}. Nested DeletionFileType is ARROW_ARRAY=0 (one Arrow IPC batch containing one Int32Array column, .arrow) or BITMAP=1 (Roaring bitmap, .bin). Comments motivate sparse versus dense selection but provide no threshold. Fields are file_type=1, read_version=2, concurrent-writer differentiating id=3, num_deleted_rows=4, and optional base_id=7 for Manifest.base_paths. samples.claim: delete_stream clones the policy Arc and wraps each successful input Path with an and_then closure. At stream polling time it locks policy, invokes every before closure with delete/location using try_for_each, releases the lock and returns a ready result carrying the unchanged Path or first error. Existing input errors bypass the closure. The transformed stream is handed to target.delete_stream immediately; whether a target stops after a stream error is dependency behavior, not established here.
samples.review_note: Matches deferred and_then policy, scoped lock and immediate delegation; preserves downstream error-consumption uncertainty.

samples.claim: field_path obtains ancestry and calls format_field_path; field_path_minimal calls the minimally quoting formatter. Missing ancestry yields Error::index with the ID. The long compiled-style doctest constructs a valid schema and asserts hyphen preservation and dotted-child roundtrip; tests were read, not executed. Formatter implementation limits are described at rust/lance-core/src/datatypes/schema.rs:1665-1735.
